I always remember the doctor describing depression to me as ‘your brain will remember the most awful, horrible thoughts ever, and it’ll replay them to you over and over again, like a record player on repeat, until you break” #MentalHealthAwarenessWeek

People still see depression as something you can ‘snap out of’, or the typical reply is “you’ve got nothing to be depressed about, cheer up”. Depression is a killer, I’ve been there, never be afraid to seek out the help you need. #MentalHealthAwarenessWeek
